Three camper cabins rent through City Hall. --Claude
summary: City page (rates updated May 2025) and 2025 brochure: $22 a night ($500 monthly, tent $10), 8 water/electric sites on gravel pads, some with sewer, shower house, dump, no RV reservations. Count corrected from the note's ~10 full-hookup sites to 8. Not waterfront kept (pond, behind trees). Note trimmed of field facts and the RV Life line.
flags: LEAD: the city's second campground, School Park Campground (309 Vine Street, Fonda; brochure: 'School Park Campground has 21 full hookups', same $22 rates, no RV reservations), is not in the database. Source: https://fondaiowa.com/parks-recreation/campgrounds/ and the 2025 brochure.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Esri: the RV row is a gravel lane of ~8 pads ~45-65 m east of the park's fountain pond (~0.7 ha, under the 5-acre line, so a pond with no pond-view value), with trees, the cabins and a lane between.
PHONE 712-288-4466 is City Hall (city page and brochure); it is the only number given. OK.
PIN: stored 42.57940,-94.84630 is ~65 m north-east of the RV row (~42.5790,-94.8469). OK.
